question:
Jeev Milkha Singh’s became the first player from India to join the European Tour in 1998. He won:

(i) four European Tour Titles

(ii) four Japan Golf Tour titles

(iii) six Asian Tour tiles
solution:
The correct answer is __**(i), (ii) and (iii).**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jeev Milkha Singh **became the** first player **from** India **to join the** European Tour in 1998.**
 
• He won **four European Tour Titles.**
 
• He also won **four Japan Golf Tour titles.**
 
• Jeev Milkha Singh won** six Asian Tour titles.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **European Tour** is one of the leading men's professional golf tours in the world.
 
• The **Japan Golf Tour** is the second-largest professional golf tour in the world.
 
• The** Asian Tour **is a professional golf tour for men that is based in Asia.
 
• **Jeev Milkha Singh** is a professional golfer from India who has won numerous tournaments throughout his career.
